name: Nusa Dua Beach Hotel and Spa - Handwritten Collection
short_description: One of Bali's oldest 5-star beachfront hotels, opened in 1983 and now part of Accor's Handwritten Collection, with 381 rooms across oceanfront grounds.
ai_summary: Nusa Dua Beach Hotel and Spa opened in 1983 as one of Bali's original 5-star beachfront properties and joined Accor's Handwritten Collection -- a soft-brand grouping of independent-feeling heritage hotels, similar in concept to Marriott's Autograph Collection -- in September 2024. Its 381 rooms and suites sit across oceanfront gardens with three pools, direct beach access, five restaurants and a kids' club, all built around authentic Balinese architecture. Reviews consistently praise the traditional design, spacious clean rooms and attentive staff, while entry-level rooms have small bathrooms without a bathtub and some fittings read as dated for a property at this tier.

pros: One of Bali's original 5-star beachfront hotels, with authentic Balinese architecture throughout
Direct beach access with pristine sand and well-maintained oceanfront gardens
Three outdoor pools, five restaurants, three bars and a kids' club across 381 rooms and suites
Spacious, clean rooms with quality furnishings
Friendly, attentive staff noted even during lower-occupancy periods
cons: Entry-level rooms have small bathrooms with no bathtub
Some toiletries and fittings read as generic and dated for the property's tier
The on-site gym is cramped relative to the hotel's overall size
research_highlights: The authentic Balinese architecture and beachfront setting are the hotel's most consistently praised features
Room space and cleanliness draw repeat praise, including in entry-level categories
Staff attentiveness stands out even when the resort isn't at full occupancy
research_watchouts: Entry-level rooms lack a bathtub and have compact bathrooms
Some fittings and toiletries feel dated relative to the hotel's 5-star, heritage positioning

faqs.question: Is Nusa Dua Beach Hotel part of Accor?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it joined Accor's Handwritten Collection, a soft-brand grouping of independent-feeling heritage hotels, in September 2024. It's the collection's debut property in Bali and participates in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

faqs.question: How old is Nusa Dua Beach Hotel?
faqs.answer: It opened in 1983, making it one of Bali's original 5-star beachfront hotels, and its 381 rooms and suites are built around traditional Balinese architecture across oceanfront gardens with direct beach access.
